guard: identity and classified offline refusal reports validate broker display addresses, redact URL user information, queries and fragments, escape terminal controls, and never return malformed raw input
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/workspace build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/cli build && pnpm exec tsx implementations/cli/smoke/who-roster.smoke.ts
why: A complete exact-source dependency build precedes the proof. Each mutation rebuilds both changed operator packages; restoration rebuilds them too.

Saved-registry cases run the real built CLI in JSON, plain and default layouts, with bare/multiple addresses, user/password, token, query, fragment and invalid input. A real offline who refusal exercises the shared renderer. Diagnostics replace every synthetic marker before logging. The original native baseline is 41 passed and 23 named privacy failures.

The real auth-required broker, reached through a manual open registry entry with synthetic URL user information, exercises the auth-mismatch recovery branch. Recovery copy requests the original URL with a placeholder, never a secret-stripped connection argument.

The expanded native corpus adds malformed host/path/scheme cases, positive TLS/WebSocket/IPv6 controls, and raw/registered terminal-control refusals. Decoded JSON message values must also be terminal-safe.
